The event source was human intervention. For example, an
administrator used Queue Viewer to delete a message, or
submitted message files using the Replay directory.
The event source was a transport agent.

The event source was the approval framework that's used
with moderated recipients. For more information, see
Manage message approval.

The event source was unprocessed messages that exist on
the server at boot time. This is related to the LOAD event
type.

The event source was a delivery status notification (also
known as a DSN, bounce message, non-delivery report, or
NDR).
